title: LAE CLASS 4 DRIVERS
industry: Driver, Heavy Equipment, Logistics, Transport and Supply
description:
LAE CLASS 4 DRIVERS
LOCATION: Lae, Malaita Street
Job Requirements
Be able to read, write and speak English.
Three years’ min of recent experience.
Experience and references from reputable employers.
Able to pass medical (including drug & alcohol) test.
Previous commercial driving experience.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Pre-departure checks on all company equipment.
Load and secure freight.
Complete site inductions and abide by all site rules.
Manage documents and paperwork.
Maintain equipment cleanliness and refuel vehicles.
Have an understand of load restraint and load weight restrictions.
Complying with company and client HSE requirements.
Qualifications
Be in possession of a
valid class 4 (heavy vehicle license).
Have a current police clearance.
Good rates await the successful candidate plus overtime.
Please apply in writing to our Transport Driver Trainer Department in Lae.
Hand deliver to the main office Malaita Street or email:
Nancy Iosea
